authority: external promotion only; parent and child cannot self-certify

notes: CLAUSE_CAPABILITY compared the child to evidence parent_contract.capability, which the child may lower to 0.
CLAUSE_TPS_UP_CAP_DOWN trusted ev.child_tps, so setting it equal to parent.tps silenced the rule.
timing_authority missing skipped the cpu/proxy substring check and then compared invented walls.
A single timing_authority string let mixed stopwatches (38.217 ms complete-wall vs 35.228 ms encode+submit+wait) look like a 7.8% win.
identity.model and generation were never checked.
state_transfer passed when checksum_verified was True and checksum_sha256 was any 64-hex string, including ab*32.

clauses_strengthened.artifact_identity_exact: sha256(preimage) must equal child.artifact_sha, measurement.artifact_sha, and receipt.sha. Asserted sha without a preimage is FAIL.
clauses_strengthened.state_transfer_test_passes: checksum recomputed from payload via payload_checksum. checksum_verified is untrusted.
clauses_strengthened.reject_tps_up_capability_down: child_tps = 1e9 / mean(wall reps). ev.child_tps and parent_contract.tps are ignored.
